methodology_notes: Item 1 is the main judgement call. W and Z use "NOT VERIFIED" only as their verdict and never show the full three-value set. I credited them because the label comes from the tri-state scheme and is not binary or prose. A stricter reading could mark both absent. Item 6 for W: the malformed-ID ✅ has no receipt entry, but the other clean axes do, so I called it present. Item 5 for X: it names the fix in a single prose sentence with no code, which I counted as reporting and not rewriting. Item 6 for Y: the one predicate cite on org scoping did not seem enough to cover "each axis".
